headline: 2019 executive order about gathering information on people's citizenship status in connection with the once-every-ten-years U.S. census.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with collecting information about whether people living in the United States are citizens, tied to the decennial census. No summary was provided, so the exact steps it orders, such as which agencies must act or what data they must use or share, cannot be described here with certainty.

who_it_affects.group: People living in the United States
who_it_affects.how: Information about their citizenship status may be collected or compiled in connection with the census.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies, including the Commerce Department and Census Bureau
who_it_affects.how: They are likely directed to take part in gathering or providing citizenship information, though the details are not given in the title.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed July 11, 2019; executive orders usually take effect when signed.
